Three unused twin tables (KNOWN_FEATURES, HEALTH_STATES, WORKUNIT_STATUSES) so FEATURE_ALIASES, STATE_*, and transition_status are each the only table.
A lying unused reserve default (8 GiB) that did not match MemGate.calculate_reserve (12 GiB / 15%).
A dead mutation validation driver that would have subprocess-run pytest -x over the workspace.
A duplicate main-guard helper in verifier_pipeline; engine.py keeps the live copy.
Unused census-tool aliases and two unused helpers (py_assert_eq, _src_has).
Call depth of every user-facing command unchanged. CommandHandler and getattr _cmd_* dispatch kept.
anti_goodhart_clause: A 20% line reduction with worse architecture would have been a failure. This is a ~156-line cut that removes one dead module and several unused twin authorities. Wrappers, fossils, sealed experiments, and compatibility re-exports were left.
